_about: Rand's Tower (levels 8-22): the tower's horrors as elites, and Rand the Dreamer himself in his bedchamber, whose dreams leak into the waking world: the light dies as he weakens, and his worst nightmares step out of the dark.

6450.name: rand dreamer wizard
6450.long_desc: Rand the Dreamer sits up in his bed, eyes open but still asleep.
6450.description: A thin old wizard in a nightshirt, his eyes wide and blind with dreaming. Everything in this tower came out of his sleep, and he has not woken in years.

phases.message: Rand sits bolt upright: "You are not part of my dream!"

abilities.name: Night Terror
abilities.telegraph: Rand screams in his sleep, and the room twists!

abilities.name: Dream Lash
abilities.telegraph: Rand flings out a hand, and the shadows lash at you!

abilities.name: Waking Nightmare
abilities.telegraph: Rand begins to dream of you...

mechanics.shout: The candles of the tower go out one by one...
Rand whimpers, and a nightmare steps out of the dark!
